item.description:
Hold My Notes 1.0.9

  • A drag handle beside the "+" carries the deck: drag it to slide the deck along its edge, or pull it out to pick the deck up and drop it on the left, right or bottom of the screen
  • Settings › General › Display: choose which display the deck appears on, or all of them
  • Settings › Keyboard: configurable hotkeys. New: ⌥⌘E changes the deck's position, ⌃⌥⌘H hides the deck and notes, ⌘, opens Settings from a note and ⌘W closes All Notes and the Archive. ⌥⌘L is now All Notes and ⌥⌘A the Archive
  • Reduced the activation area for the sticky notes deck
  • Added an activation-delay setting: a slider from 0 to 1 s (default 50 ms)
  • Fixed a bug where an unpinned note closed when it lost focus
  • Settings can be resized, and the app shows up in ⌘-Tab
